text: Replace control search with a lightweight indexed in-memory fuzzy search
description: Replace the current linear-scan custom fuzzy matcher with a proper lightweight in-memory indexed fuzzy search implementation. Preserve domain-specific ranking by scoring full control paths and direct control names separately, then combine them so direct name hits rank above broad path-only matches. Explicitly explore ranking full-path score and control-name score independently and multiplying or otherwise combining them to boost controls whose leaf/name and path both match well.

status.comment: Requested follow-up after initial custom matcher; target is a lightweight indexed fuzzy search with combined path/name ranking.
